title: Emi
summary: Emi is a Seeker working for the Huntik Foundation who carries out research at a university in Naha, Japan. Emi's ancestors were Seekers from the age of the Samurai and she comes from a family of ninjas, so she is an expert in ninjitsu. Den Fears quickly developed a crush on her during their mission to find the Titan Kyojin in Japan.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
As a young child, Emi saw [[Wilder]] approach  attack her village but he was defeated by her father. {{source|The Guardian of Yonaguni}}

Years later, Emi came to [[Dante Vale's house]] in need of help, pursed by a [[Shadow Agent]] Titan. She enlisted their help to find the island of Yonaguni and its Titan guardian, [[Kyojin]]. As the team battled the Organization, Emi remembered Wilder from her past and defeated him using the move that she watched her father do. After realising that part of the sunken city itself was the Titan, [[Lok Lambert]] summoned Kyojin, defeating the Organization forces, and then gave Kyojin's [[Amulet]] to Emi to thank her for saving them. {{source|The Guardian of Yonaguni}}

full_text:
Emi is a Seeker working for the Huntik Foundation who carries out research at a university in Naha, Japan. Emi's ancestors were Seekers from the age of the Samurai and she comes from a family of ninjas, so she is an expert in ninjitsu. Den Fears quickly developed a crush on her during their mission to find the Titan Kyojin in Japan.

History

As a young child, Emi saw Wilder approach attack her village but he was defeated by her father. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]

Years later, Emi came to Dante Vale's house in need of help, pursed by a Shadow Agent Titan. She enlisted their help to find the island of Yonaguni and its Titan guardian, Kyojin. As the team battled the Organization, Emi remembered Wilder from her past and defeated him using the move that she watched her father do. After realising that part of the sunken city itself was the Titan, Lok Lambert summoned Kyojin, defeating the Organization forces, and then gave Kyojin's Amulet to Emi to thank her for saving them. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]

Abilities

Raised in a family of ninjas, Emi is a trained ninja and is extremely skilled in using different ninja weapons including a staff and a rope.

Bonded Titans

Kyojin — comic — Given to her by Lok after she helped the Huntik team.

'''Emi''' is a [[Seeker]] working for the [[Huntik Foundation]] who carries out research at a university in [[Naha, Japan]]. Emi's ancestors were Seekers from the age of the Samurai and she comes from a family of ninjas, so she is an expert in ninjitsu. [[Den Fears]] quickly developed a crush on her during their mission to find the Titan [[Kyojin]] in Japan. 

== History==
As a young child, Emi saw [[Wilder]] approach  attack her village but he was defeated by her father. {{source|The Guardian of Yonaguni}}

Years later, Emi came to [[Dante Vale's house]] in need of help, pursed by a [[Shadow Agent]] Titan. She enlisted their help to find the island of Yonaguni and its Titan guardian, [[Kyojin]]. As the team battled the Organization, Emi remembered Wilder from her past and defeated him using the move that she watched her father do. After realising that part of the sunken city itself was the Titan, [[Lok Lambert]] summoned Kyojin, defeating the Organization forces, and then gave Kyojin's [[Amulet]] to Emi to thank her for saving them. {{source|The Guardian of Yonaguni}}

== Abilities ==
Raised in a family of ninjas, Emi is a trained ninja and is extremely skilled in  using different ninja weapons including a staff and a rope.
